persons.name: Jayaraṇajitamalla
persons.evidence: śrī śrījayaraṇajitamalla mahārājasana ... ṭīkādayakaṃ sidhayakā julo

persons.name: Yajñanārāyaṇa
persons.evidence: yajñanārāyaṇapradhānāṃgayā valasa thva guli siddhayoga saṃgrahanāma aśvaśāstrayā nepālabhāṣāna ṭīkādayakaṃ sidhayakā julo

relations.evidence: jīpanisayā makhu, svāmiyā ājñāmātra yathā śaktina praṃāṇa yāṅā

notes: The colophon records the completion of the Newari (Nepālabhāṣā) commentary/translation of the Siddhayogasaṃgraha Aśvaśāstra commissioned by King Jayaraṇajitamalla and prepared with the agency of Yajñanārāyaṇa Pradhānāṅga.
